  - **Period / Tournament Diff**: Compares two time windows (`split_half`, `last7_vs_prev`, or 2 tournaments) with Blue/Red WR shifts and rising/falling hero priority deltas (`computePeriodDiff`, `splitGamesForPeriodDiff`).

    - **Relative Risk & Usage Skewness**: Member vs Guest return `RR`, dispersion index (`Var/Mean`), Gini coefficient, Pareto Top-10% share, Gamma-Poisson next-day load forecast, Binomial Z-test for AI Top-5 Trust vs random (`5/130`), and p50/p95 latency quantiles.
- **Dashboard Visualization (`frontend/src/components/AdminDashboardView.tsx`, `types/auth.ts`):**

**Agent:** Antigravity

### ✅ Completed Work
- **Payload Cache + 100ms Debounce + 429 UX (`frontend/src/hooks/useDraft.ts`):**

    - Rapidly toggling Swap Sides when Global Bans are symmetric/empty (e.g. Game 1) triggers **0** duplicate `POST /predict` requests.

## 📅 2026-11-04 18:05 (UTC+7) — Fix Search Input Key Hijacking & Win Rate Preservation on Redo
**Agent:** Claude Code (`ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high`)

### ✅ Completed Work
- **Prevent Search Input Shortcut Hijacking (`DraftBoardView.tsx`)**:
  - Added an early `if (typing) return;` check in the global `keydown` event listener in `DraftBoardView.tsx`.
  - Fixes an issue where typing into the hero search input box and pressing `Ctrl+Z` or `Ctrl+Y` triggered draft turn undo/redo instead of native browser text editing undo/redo.
- **Preserve Win Probability History on Redo (`draft.ts`)**:
  - Previously, `undo` truncated `winHistory` up to the current step via `winHistory.slice(...)`, which caused subsequent `redo` (Forward) actions to find an `undefined` win rate at future steps and temporarily flash the win rate back to `50.0%` until the async `/predict` API responded.
  - Updated `draftReducer`:
    - `undo`: preserves `winHistory` and retrieves `winHistory[last.stepIndex]`.
    - `redo`: retrieves the saved `winHistory[next.stepIndex]`, maintaining seamless win rate display without flashing to `50.0%`.
    - `lock`: trims `winHistory.slice(0, state.stepIndex + 1)` only when a new hero is locked, properly clearing the invalidated future branch.
- **Headless Browser Automated Suite Run**:
  - Ran a 46-scenario Playwright headless browser test covering complete 18-step drafts, single & multi-step undo/redo, branching history invalidation, modal backdrop drag-release dismissal protection, and mobile responsive controls.

**Agent:** Claude Code (`ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high`)

### ✅ Completed Work
- **Matrix Counter Directionality Fix (`src/predictor.py`)**:
  - In `predict_matrix()`, corrected matrix-vector multiplication orientation for skew-symmetric counter matrices: `cnt_scores = cnt_mat @ ep_row` (candidate advantage over enemy picks) and `cnt_risks = ep_row @ cnt_mat` (enemy picks advantage over candidate). Previously transposed products reversed counter advantage, subtracting 3.2x advantage and recommending countered heroes.
  - Wrapped `series_winning_heroes` resolution in `set(...)` across `_evaluate_with_forecasts()` and `predict()` to prevent compounding multipliers on duplicate inputs.

  - Updated `run_model()` in Minimax lookahead to mask probabilities post-softmax with `unavail` tensor (`probs = probs.masked_fill(unavail, 0.0)`) and renormalize across positive rows, ensuring unavailable heroes are strictly zeroed out even in exhaustive ban states.

  - Enforced RoV game mechanics in `simulate_duel()`: physical `life_steal` applies exclusively to `"Normal Attack"` events, preventing physical ability casters from abnormally lifestealing off physical skill hits.
  - Clamped `_pick()` index with `max(0, min(len(values) - 1, skill_level - 1))` and clamped `MAX_LEVEL` indexing, preventing negative index wrap-around to max skill ranks.
  - Capped `skill_hits` upper bound to 50 hits and added colloquial Arcana aliases `"Sap"` -> `"Bloodlust (Magic)"` and `"Greed"` -> `"Reave"`.

## 📅 2026-10-31 17:15 (UTC+7) — Upgrade Synergy & Counter Engine to Bradley-Terry Log-Odds Delta-2 & Direct In-Lane 1v1
**Agent:** Claude Code (`ag/gemini-4-argon-high`)

### ✅ Completed Work
- **Bradley-Terry Log-Odds Delta-2 & Empirical Bayes Shrinkage**:
  - Replaced naive `0.50` baseline subtraction in `src/build_draft_stats.py`, `src/train_sota_model.py`, and `scripts/export_commercial_package.py` with the Bradley-Terry Log-Odds model:
    - Bayesian base win probability: `p_i = (wins_i + 5.0) / (picks_i + 10.0)` and `logit(p_i) = ln(p_i / (1 - p_i))`.
    - Expected synergy win rate: `E_synergy(A, B) = sigmoid(logit(p_A) + logit(p_B))`.
    - Expected counter win rate: `E_counter(A, B) = sigmoid(logit(p_A) - logit(p_B))`.
    - Empirical Bayes posterior win rate (`K = 12` for all-role pairs, `K = 8` for direct in-lane 1v1 pairs): `Posterior_WR = (Wins + K * Expected_WR) / (Games + K)`.
    - `Delta-2` interaction lift (`Posterior_WR - Expected_WR`) and Binomial `Z-score` to isolate true mechanical synergy and counter value from individual hero base win-rate confounding.
- **Role-Aware Direct In-Lane 1v1 Matchup Separation & Kit Mechanism Grounding**:
  - Added exact post-swap same-lane (`i == j` across `DS_Lane, Jungle, Mid, Dragon_Lane, Roam`) tracking in `src/build_draft_stats.py` (`data/counter_matrix.csv`) and a dedicated 6th worksheet `Direct_Lane_Counters_2026` (`raw_csv/direct_lane_counters_2026.csv`) in `scripts/export_commercial_package.py`.
  - Added primary role-pair tracking (`Primary_Lane_Pair`, e.g., `Jungle + Roam`, `DS_Lane + Jungle`, `Dragon_Lane + Mid`) and mechanical kit tags (`True Damage vs Shield/Sustain`, `CC Immunity vs Hard CC`, `Hard CC Lockdown vs Mobile Target`, `CC Setup + Finisher Combo`).

## 📅 2026-10-31 11:20 (UTC+7) — Lock SOTA Architecture & Add Performance-Adjusted Regional League Conditioning
**Agent:** Claude Code (`ag/gemini-4-argon-high`)

### ✅ Completed Work
- **Locked Structural Transformer Architecture (`d_model=256, num_layers=1, nhead=4`)**:
  - Locked `num_layers = 1`, `d_model = 256`, and `nhead = 4` across `src/hpo_sota_optuna.py`, `src/train_sota_model.py`, and `src/config.py`.
  - Theoretical & empirical grounding: Draft sequence length is at most 17 tokens (`MAX_HISTORY_LEN = 17`), so 1 self-attention layer provides a 100% global receptive field; 4 of 5 top H100 HPO candidates selected `num_layers = 1`, with Trial #43 achieving the safest overfit gap (`+0.26490`) and highest win-value accuracy (`55.41%`).
- **Implemented Unified Model with Performance-Adjusted Regional League Conditioning (`RPL`, `AOG`, `GCS`, `INTL`, `GLOBAL`)**:
  - Analyzed 3,477 matches (2025–2026) across RPL (1,077), AOG (1,199), GCS (661), and APL/AIC (540): splitting into 3 separate models drops GNN pairwise graph coverage by 43%–60%, while unconditioned global training penalizes GCS validation loss (`2.9191` vs `2.7685` in RPL) because GCS has 6 teams (fewer matches) despite a `52.3%` international win rate in APL/AIC (`RPL = 53.7%`, `GCS = 52.3%`, `AOG = 44.7%`).
  - Added `PERFORMANCE_GLOBAL_LEAGUE_WEIGHTS = (0.32, 0.20, 0.30, 0.18)` and `LEAGUE_SAMPLE_WEIGHTS = (1.05, 0.75, 1.35, 1.15)` in `src/train_sota_model.py` to weight global priors and sample losses by international competitive strength rather than raw match volume.
  - Added Dirichlet-smoothed regional priors (`league_pick_log_priors`, `league_ban_p1_log_priors`, `league_ban_p2_log_priors` of shape `(4, 130)`), 11-dim `meta_ctx` (`7` base features + `4` league conditioning features), and a 9th learnable fusion weight in `w_pick / w_ban1 / w_ban2` inside `RoVDraftGNNTransformer` with full backward compatibility for existing 7-dim checkpoints.
  - Threaded `league: Literal["RPL", "AOG", "GCS", "INTL", "GLOBAL"] = "GLOBAL"` through `DraftStateRequest` (`src/schemas.py`), `RoVDraftPredictor` (`src/predictor.py`), and `DraftMinimaxSearch` (`src/search/draft_mcts.py`).

    1. **Counter Priority**: Compares available hero against locked enemy picks using `counter_mat`. If advantage >= +2.0%, tags `trigger_reason="counter"` with up to 2 countered enemy heroes.

## 📅 2026-10-21 (UTC+7) — ปรับ data structure / algorithm ของ predictor (`/predict` เร็วขึ้น 2–3 เท่า ผลลัพธ์เหมือนเดิมทุกตัว)
**Agent:** Claude Code (Opus 5.5)

### ✅ สิ่งที่ทำ
- `_build_ban_pick_intel_tables`: แปลงทุกเกมเป็น one-hot matrix (1 แถวต่อทีมต่อเกม) แล้วนับ co-occurrence ด้วย matmul (`bans.T @ picks` ฯลฯ) และคำนวณ lift/score ด้วย numpy mask ทั้งตาราง แทนลูป Python 130×130 สองชุด
- `_sum_contributions`: ใช้แทน `_compute_ban_unlocked_scores`/`_compute_pick_to_ban_scores` ดึงแถวของฮีโร่ต้นเหตุมาเรียงด้วย `lexsort` แล้วรวมทั้งแกน (ลำดับบวกและการเลือก trigger เท่าเดิม รวมถึงกรณีคะแนนเท่ากัน)
- `_build_hero_tables`: เตรียม lane, role และ capability เป็น list ตาม hero id ตอนโหลด แทน pandas `.loc` ที่เคยกินราว 22% ของเวลา predict
- รวมการทำนายฝั่งน้ำเงิน/แดง (ตำแหน่งหลัก, next bans ×2, next pick ตาแรก ×2) เป็น batch เดียว ตาที่สองเป็นอีก batch: forward pass จาก 5 ครั้งเหลือ 2
- `draft_mcts.py`: เพิ่ม `ModelInput` + `encode_batch` + `run_model` ใช้ร่วมกันแทนโค้ด one-hot/sequence-token ที่ซ้ำ 4 ที่, `find_matching_step` เปลี่ยนเป็น dict ที่สร้างครั้งเดียว และย้ายการสร้าง unavailable set ออกนอกลูป
